intro: Heel Care Balm is formulated to nourish extremely dry, cracked heels with rich emollients and ayurvedic botanicals. With consistent use, it softens hard skin, reduces rough patches, and improves overall heel smoothness for sandal‑ready feet. Ideal for daily maintenance as well as intensive overnight care; results vary by routine and severity of dryness.

li: Intensive ayurvedic heel balm that helps heal the look of deep cracks and rough, dry heels.
Deeply moisturizes to soften callused skin and improve texture for smoother, comfortable feet.
Fast‑absorbing, non‑greasy feel suitable for daily day‑night foot care routine.
Works well under socks/overnight; supports barrier repair and hydration retention.
Travel‑friendly 25 g jar with secure gold cap for hygienic storage.
Soak or wash feet, pat dry. Apply a pea‑sized amount to heels and rough areas; massage until absorbed.
Use twice daily; for severe cracks apply a thicker layer at night and wear cotton socks.
1 x Heel Care Balm, 25 g jar
Adults with dry, rough or cracked heels and callused feet; suitable for most skin types.
External use only; avoid broken/bleeding skin and contact with eyes. Discontinue if irritation occurs.
Cosmetic/ayurvedic topical care; no medical claims. Store cool and dry.
